summary: Name empty thread tabs and explain empty and read-only threads

replay.detail: Rendering only; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread access and mutation rules are unchanged; read-only connections still get no composer or actions.

compatibility.detail: Clients and daemons interoperate as before.

manual.detail: Open a thread with no messages in its own tab on a read-only pairing: the tab shows 'Title · to <agent name> · open', 'No messages yet.' and 'Read-only on this device: replies and changes need write access.' An expanded empty thread in a list shows 'No messages yet.' under its heading.
